Faculty Review: ZRU (Geo205,Env203)
He is the most amazing person I have ever witnessed at NSU not only because of his teaching style, but also for his friendly and helpful attitude. 
He will be the most easy going as well as informative person you will find. Throughout the semester, he will share all of his experiences of his long teaching career and you will get any sort of help from him.
Most importantly, he knows GED courses are not like any major courses and hence, you will not be getting any pressure you face in so many other GED courses. 
Furthermore, he will provide so many suggestions before exam and makes mid/final questions accordingly. And again, he will give bonus marks. Thus you will get a very decent grade from him only if you focus a bit on those.
The reason behind giving this post is, faculty like him proves that NSU is still one of the best university of the country which will provide you so many talented mind.
Consider yourself a very lucky person if you get the chance of doing his course.

nik.review:
Dr Nahreen Islam Khan (NIK)
GEO205/ENV203, MW 09:25am
This was miss’s first semester at NSU, hence I was confused as to how to approach this course. But as it turns out, if you study the very little, and very easy content covered, and interact and answer questions, and just be confident during the presentation, you can do really well. When writing answers in the exams, make sure your answers are sufficiently long, look organised, and maybe add a diagram. For the presentation, follow her instruction on how to make the slides, and when speaking and answering the questions anfterwards, just speak with conviction. It can be a tricky to score marks, but I guess there will be curving at the end.
